name: Apple Hospitality REIT (APLE)
teaser: Watchlist for new money. Apple Hospitality's hotels are full again and the quarter was strong, but cash earnings per share are back at 2018 levels and $18.87 already pays for the recovery; Base $18.96, buy zone $13.27.
llms: Apple Hospitality REIT (APLE), listed on the NYSE, owns 216 rooms-focused Hilton, Marriott and Hyatt hotels in 37 states and pays a monthly dividend of $0.96 a year. Valued with a five-year cash flow model to shareholders after hotel capital spending, interest and stock pay, and a private-market asset value of the hotels at a 7.25% cap rate. Third quarter 2026 comparable RevPAR rose 7.3% and MFFO per share 16.3%, but 2026 MFFO per share of about $1.71 is close to the $1.72 of 2018; the price implies a 7.2% cap rate on 2027 hotel income. Bear $13.19, Base $18.96, Bull $22.23. Verdict Hold at $18.87 (November 6, 2026 NYSE close), maximum buy price $13.27.
